beats.headline: Havana, before
beats.text: Donut picks Cuba over the Bahamas book Carl bought, and they come up inside Havana's capitol on December 10th, before the collapse. The whole floor is a replay of the world weeks before it ended, full of memory ghosts who walk through you, and every monster is a local legend. Each squad gets twenty flags: plant one in a monster below five per cent and it becomes a T'Ghee card, a totem you can summon. Fill six slots in fourteen days. Mordecai is a pink hills cyclops, and finally tells the story behind his hatred. On his own tenth floor his brother Uzzi died because Odette refused to pay the sponsor of a storm goddess, and had Chaco put a god-summoning dart into Uzzi instead of letting Mordecai sacrifice himself. For killing every hunter on the last floor Carl gets a Celestial box, and from it the Scavenger's Daughter, a divine jacket patch that eats souls. Donut becomes a Master Telephone Psychic whose best spell makes monsters stab themselves. Their first monster is a wolf with Che Guevara's head. Their first allies are three Cubans, Paz, his cousin Anton and a cat-girl nun called Sister Ines, who arrive hostile because of something Donut once said about cat girls to a stripper. Together they flag a kung-fu monk seal called Geraldo and stumble into the Chowder War, crabs against seals. The pacifist network asks, through Zev, for Carl to go on a show called Shadow Boxer.

beats.headline: Shadow Boxer
beats.text: The card rules arrive at length: a squad leader in deck combat loses spells and inventory until the deck is spent, and the squad has to keep them alive. Samantha writes from inside a spider demigoddess in the southern swamps, a woman of many names, one of them the Bedlam Bride, who says she is looking for her husband. In the practice arena Donut's four cards float in front of her face like a windshield, and Geraldo arrives flipping, in a headband covered in hearts. A cemetery hides a corrupted town, and Paz's Santero class wakes the dead. A dying orisha called Asojano, Lord of Smallpox, follows them into the saferoom and asks Paz to repair his shrine. Donut's fans vote her a golden headset that finally lets her sing in tune. Then Shadow Boxer, whose host is Rosetta Thagra, a former crawler whose note Carl has read in the Cookbook's bomb chapter. She interviews Donut about Gossip Girl. She asks Carl about his mother, and Donut learns for the first time that his mother hanged herself and that he found her. Rosetta shows him a faked photograph with a jug of milk in it and asks about potatoes, and the room blinks. Harbinger, the caprid liaison who once helped Maggie My, stops the interview and bans her for talking in code. Quasar brings news of the ninth floor: the high elf castle came down on the Lemig Sortion's army and splattered half of it.

beats.headline: Seven shrines
beats.text: Carl rolls troll-smoke bombs down the street and Bomo carries the terrified Paz across a graveyard to Asojano's temple. Inside is a thorn room with seven broken shrines and enough power to fix one. Gods appear from every side to argue their case. Paz and Anton's own god, Ogun, demands they choose his, and Katia messages Carl alone: fix Yemaya's, because it is the first step towards getting the Crown of the Sepsis Whore off her head. Anton, charmed, throws Ogun's piece out of the door. Bomo builds Yemaya's shrine like Tetris, Donut and Mongo take Asojano apart, and Carl flags him a heartbeat before he dies. Ogun comes for his worshippers. He burns an unhealable handprint into Paz's face and crushes Anton's head underfoot while Carl tries to shield him. Dying, Paz tells them what Sister Ines is: a cat girl whose race makes everyone near her protect her, and before the crawl the Reaper of Havana, who poisoned every sister in her convent. Paz asks to be let go, and she stabs a flag into his neck and turns him into a card. Yemaya rises, sends Bomo off to join the Sledge, and brings Eileithyia, a goddess driven by Huanxin Jinx, the sponsor whose price Odette refused on Mordecai's tenth floor. In secret Eileithyia offers Carl a deal: accept Odette as adjutant, and she will fix the votes and the crown. Katia's way out is a flower in a sealed box. Eating it grants one of Eileithyia's boons: become a celestial attendant on the twelfth floor, or become pregnant and leave the crawl. The last seal is a contract from the Night Wyrm's guild: kill Astrid.

beats.headline: The planning table
beats.text: Mordecai has quietly hired the sickest of the changeling children as his room attendants and set up a split controller on the floor for Ruby, who has no arms. The ninth floor's warlords meet virtually around a table: an orc prince, a naga, a blob, a surfer goblin called Luke, Empress D'nadia, a robot, a masked Viceroy. The Viceroy's head comes off mid-sentence. Juice Box is sitting in his chair wearing Epitome's mother's face, and since she is an NPC on nobody's team, the rules cannot touch her. Her price for stopping is a tenth team, made of the floor's own NPCs, with the same protections as the nine. Carl files it as an action item, and within minutes Prince Stalwart takes a magical arrow through the eye. Florin hands Donut the card of Uzi Jesus, a zombie gunman who once shot him. In the Penis Parade, the strip club off the top floor of the Desperado Club, a dancer called Damascus Steel walks Carl through the back of a cubicle to the Guild of Suffering. A voice in the dark gives him a map of the club's secret passages. They flag Raul, a meditating land crab who calls himself worthless, by dropping him through the floor of a box truck. Then they reach Samantha and her new friend Shi Maria, the Bedlam Bride. Carl sees through the spider's act and makes a deal: she becomes a card in their deck, and they carry her to the next floor.

beats.headline: Astrid
beats.text: Phases two and three are announced. Each squad leader is sent somewhere new to fetch a stairwell key, and squads without one are thrown against the squads that have one. Katia is out of it on a drug from a hidden bar in the club, reliving her baby daughter, and Imani and Mordecai start her cure. Empress D'nadia sells her sponsorship of Donut to a garbage-hauling company. In practice fights Shi Maria opens her fifth eye and something tugs at the river in the back of Carl's mind. Carl insists on the assassination anyway. He lays teleport traps in the service corridor Astrid uses and walls off a door marked with a warning. Samantha's distraction goes too far, into the casino, and pulls Minge, a feral demon and Slit's little sister, out of a door into the Nothing. Astrid is braver than anyone expected: she releases the vorpals, god-deputised suicide troops, to kill the demon. In the club kitchen Katia's totems pin her, Carl pulls her wings off, and a spike goes through her head. Before she dies she asks Carl to tell her husband she did it to keep them safe. Her husband is Hamed, the Night Wyrm, the demigod who ordered the killing. Two dancers are crying on the floor of the Penis Parade: Damascus Steel and Anaconda, her sons. Astrid and the Night Wyrm were crawlers once, long ago, and never left. Damascus makes Carl hire every male dancer in the club as mercenaries with his coupon before the restructuring comes, then walks off with his brother to find their father. Katia has the orchid.

beats.headline: The Keys
beats.text: On Odette's show Carl tells the galaxy that the faction officials who got flushed into the shark-filled ruins of Larracos should be thanking him. Odette shows D'nadia's rejected action items, one of which would have deleted Carl and Donut outright. Then she does not ask to be their adjutant. She has sponsored a goddess of her own, Nekhebit, and is going into the Ascendency herself, so the whole segment was a press conference. They pick Baroness Victory instead. In fifteen minutes off the record Odette tells Carl her real reason: every world the crawl is run on is burned for fuel, she means to shut it down, and the guilt over Uzzi drives everything she does. Eileithyia keeps the deal, and promises to crush everyone Carl loves if he ever warns Odette. Donut goes into the phase-two choosing room alone and terrified. She picks Miami, a glitch drops them in the Florida Keys, and the key sits on top of a chunk of Iowa that has been set down on the reef. The squads are scattered all over the world, and some of the key sites are cruel. Imani's is in her childhood home in Detroit. Katia's is Tran's family's apartment in Da Nang. They fight their way through nine deckmasters for tokens. Asojano and Uzi Jesus merge into a single totem called Lazarus-A-Bang-Bang. After one close fight Donut admits she is frightened and does not want to be in charge, and Carl reads someone on her feed threatening to stop watching because she is whiny. He turns the screen off, and they nap in a chair.

beats.headline: Asher
beats.text: Jola, a house-sized Yule Cat Katia gave Donut, eats a Nightgaunt. In a barn full of turkeys a necromancer ogre pins Carl, pierced and blind, and whispers that they are starved, and that he could satiate them all. Raul breaks her staff and takes her head, and the Scavenger's Daughter obliterates a turkey god with a kick that tilts the barn off the mountain. Then the key-holder's trailer, which Donut does not want him to enter because she recognised the motorcycle outside. It is a single-wide in a summer yard spliced into December, with his father's Harley out front. Inside, a recording: his father, yellow and dying in a hospital bed, cursing the Mariners. A young wife in scrubs. And a six-year-old boy with Carl's nose. Asher. Carl has a brother, and learns it today. His stepmother fills a syringe with morphine and says yes, it is about time. Carl does not watch. He takes the Glock, the boy's crayon drawings and a Centipede cabinet, and sets fire to the drapes. The boss is the Reminiscence Hydra, nine heads wearing the faces of people from his life, among them Bea's mother and Asher, who fires lightning at him and asks why he never visited. Shi Maria bites the Asher head off to let it rest, and says Carl owes her something now; her fifth eye has done something to him. Afterwards Donut tells him Bea ran his Facebook, got a coworker fired for asking him out, and knew about Asher all along. Until today he was never angry at her.

beats.headline: Residuals
beats.text: Louis insists on Christmas. On the recap Orren tells the galaxy that the AI has taken the controls from the showrunners and has settled most of them back in exchange for concessions. Every faction on the ninth floor tries to withdraw, and the AI refuses them all. Carl's pacifist network sends a crumpled flyer: a homeless shelter in Homestead, breakfast at seven. Zev warns him that the box was seized days ago and that everyone in the charity has vanished, Rosetta included. At the shelter a man in a red trapper hat gives the same speech he has given every morning for a year, in case a crawler ever stood there. He is Goff, a Residual, one of thousands waiting on Earth to teach the new AI something. Let me tell you how to shut off the, he begins, and Orren yanks Carl out, calling it a trap meant to trigger the failsafe. Agatha is a Residual too, of a different kind. Phase three. Only two squads in Cuba hold keys, Carl's and Sister Ines's. Imani's own totem killed her whole squad. She arrives in Cuba with no key and runs into a saferoom, and Quan Ch is waiting outside it. The Chowder War collapses into slaughter, Sister Ines charms a city boss serpent and an army of zombie seals and crabs, and so much dies at once that Sheol overflows. A Demon Eviction begins, sending demons up into every fresh corpse.

beats.headline: Nobody gets left behind
beats.text: Quan Ch plays Force Play twice. Sister Ines and Donut both flee, and both keys go to him. He surfaces at the exit Tserendolgor's squad is holding, and Carl throws Samantha fifteen kilometres to deliver himself there. Jola strips Quan naked, a golden Uzi Jesus empties two guns into him, and dying he asks for the For Daddy ring back. Carl drops it in his hand. But the door is failing, Donut is kilometres away, and there is no time to hand a key across. Ren confesses to Donut that she cheated at the pet show, hands Carl her gear, and brings the building down on herself. The keys are Donut's. Then Carl and Prepotente work out a way to save everyone without one. A demon prince called Amayon, trapped in Ines's serpent, is casting a spell to go home that will suck every soul in its range upward. If crawlers tunnel under their stairwell chambers, it might tear the walls away and pull them up in. Everyone digs. Lucia's parting gift of Doggy Door upgrades brings Katia, Elle, Imani and Li Na's squads to the church, and Carl realises that what was breaking them all along was loneliness. Louis kills Sister Ines while she sleeps, and her patron goddess Ysalte arrives to claim the demon. Raul fertilises an ocean of crab eggs to refill the world with souls. Carl burns himself down to two per cent to unleash his Martyr's Path fire, and a warped Paz, summoned by the goddess herself, kills her with Katia's god-killing bolt. Amayon casts. Shi Maria takes Carl's body, tears out Li Jun's eye and eats it, then tattoos herself into Carl's chest. The viewers vote the sponsors' protections off by ninety-eight per cent and seat the tenth team, and Carl and Donut ride the stairwell down to the war, together. Above the planet, a garbage freighter carrying fifty thousand former crawlers requests clearance.
